answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced by a capped endorsement lattice. Each verified identity may co-sign two newcomers per epoch, each signature staked. If a sponsored key equivocates, the slash climbs the tree at half strength per hop, so the sponsor and its sponsor both lose money. A farm cannot buy entry: it needs a wide grove of independent endorsers, each with a scarce slate, stakes burning together when a leaf misbehaves. The kernel of the check is depth: one bad leaf contaminates its branch. Growth stays flat and wide, a mesa rather than a tower, because rate limits bound the graph.
